content:
Last month, Anthropic announced plans to expand Claude Cowork from Mac to iPhone and iPad. This rollout is being made available first to users on Anthropic's most expensive paid plan.

Anthropic said that as of today, Claude Cowork has completed its full rollout across mobile and desktop, and is now available to users on all paid plans.

For more details on the release of the mobile version of Anthropic Claude Cowork, click here.

On the other hand, OpenAI has also launched its own solution, ChatGPT Work, which likewise supports iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web version.
